How Apple makes money: revenue by product in 2025 and 2026

applescoop.org/story/how-apple-makes-money-revenue-by-product-iphone-services
The short answer: Apple made $416.2 billion in revenue in its 2025 fiscal year, which ended on September 27, 2025. The iPhone brought in $209.6 billion, about half the total. Services such as the App Store, iCloud and Apple Music were the second-biggest business at $109.2 billion, followed by wearables, Mac and iPad.
